'''Bosrik Mak-Ageejay''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] financial advisor for [[Regency Spires Imperial Trust]] on [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]]. He was known to secure funds to supply arms to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] by borrowing money from [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Dennix Graeber]].<ref name="Coruscant and the Core Worlds">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>
